description: This file is a source code file defining a module that provides a class for importing both CommonJS and ESM modules in Node.js. It includes helper functions for path normalization and methods for resolving and importing modules based on a given specifier.

classes.name: ModuleImporter
classes.description: A class for importing both CommonJS and ESM modules in Node.js environments, with methods for resolving module locations and importing modules asynchronously.

methods.name: normalizeDirectory
methods.description: Ensures directory paths have a trailing slash to avoid issues with parent directory lookup.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier to its absolute path using Node.js createRequire.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports a module asynchronously based on its specifier, resolving its location first.
